# vaultwarden_organization_group (Data Source)

This data source gets a group of a Vaultwarden organization by its ID or name.

Groups require the `ORG_GROUPS_ENABLED=true` setting on the Vaultwarden server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vaultwarden_organization_group" "by_name" {
  organization_id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  name            = "Engineering"
}

data "vaultwarden_organization_group" "by_id" {
  organization_id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  id              = "e5f6a7b8-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization that the group belongs to

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the group. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set
- `name` (String) The name of the group to look up, compared exactly. Group names are not unique: when several groups have the name, the lookup fails and lists their IDs. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the group
